summary: Reported the repeat of the multi-node experiment honestly and submitted a revised authority experiment. Receipt fe822d82c6264158826e0303b4ce59b1 reproduced the commit-rule case (events 2-4: snapshot-era three-voter configuration against a log whose configuration entry has two voters, commit at index 10 with only the removed server's acknowledgement), the durable-snapshot case (events 6-8: empty configuration at index 0 in the snapshot metadata, empty after a flag-off restart) and the availability case (events 11, 13) with identical operands, but did not reproduce the authority witness: A's persisted commit index was 0 in that execution, so restoreFromCommittedLogs left lastApplied at zero, the scan started at index 1, A recovered the three-voter configuration (event 15) and did attempt candidacy with 255 of 267 samples in Candidate (event 16), which is why the comparison returned unknown. The configuration-recovery account now states that precondition in its authority paragraph (a non-zero persisted commit index at restart), cites the repeat across all four cases, adds counterevidence and a limitation recording that the witness currently has one valid execution, and submits a revised harness that keeps committing until A's store reports a non-zero commit index before restarting it (reported as premise_filler_applies, previous_id 7db8c9fb0d794b08892b9349c54fa466-experiment); three local construction runs of the revised case reproduced the witness deterministically. Its receipt remains to be cited if the run allows.
